performance.verdict: Meta went dark Aug 6; organic holds but paid engine is off.

findings.text: Spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 — 20 consecutive zero-spend days. All 21 leads and $574.80 spent came before Aug 6.
GHL shows 26 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads that arrived pre-Aug 6 are not converting into pipeline, signaling an intake leak.
3-day signal (Aug 23–25): sc_clicks averaged 18.7/day vs 27.3/day in Aug 20–22 prior window — search traffic declining despite zero paid spend cushion.
Pre-dark CPL was $27.37 on 21 leads; the 3/day July volume target was being met at $65–75/day, so efficiency baseline was intact before the blackout.
IG reach spiked to 248 on Aug 25 despite zero paid spend — organic content is live but disconnected from any paid amplification.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore Meta spend; account has been dark 20 days with $0 delivered against $65–75/day SOW budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has delivered $0 in spend every day from Aug 6–25 (20 consecutive days), against a SOW budget of $65–75/day. Pull the account for billing holds, policy flags, payment failures, or ad set disapprovals and resolve the root cause immediately. Success is confirmed when daily spend returns to ≥$65/day and leads resume — target resolution by Aug 28. Do not scale or shift budget until the account is confirmed active.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 26 contacts arrived but 0 opportunities created — confirm Andrew's pipeline stages are capturing leads correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 26 contacts over the 28-day window but shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem — the leads arrived but are not entering the pipeline. Coordinate with Andrew to confirm Zoho/GHL stage mapping is correct and that lead notifications are firing. Success check: at least 50% of new contacts should have a corresponding opportunity created within 48 hours of the next lead batch arriving.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks recovery: averaged 18.7/day (Aug 23–25) vs 27.3/day prior 3 days — re-check Aug 29 for continued decline.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks dropped from a 3-day average of 27.3 (Aug 20–22) to 18.7 (Aug 23–25), a ~31% dip with no paid search active to support volume. This is worth watching but not acting on yet — one window is not a trend. Re-check on Aug 29: if the 3-day average falls below 15 clicks/day, escalate to SEO for a technical or ranking review.
